comment: Chlorination of S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM) yielding 5-Chloro-5-deoxyadenosine (5′-ClDA) in the salinosporamide A pathway. Fluorination is not possible. In this case, SAM is both a cofactor and carrier molecule.

reactions.description: Single chlorination of SAM yielding  5′-ClDA and L-Methionin through SN2 nucleophilic substitution
Single bromination of SAM yielding  5′-BrDA and L-Methionin through SN2 nucleophilic substitution
Single iodization of SAM yielding  5′-IDA and L-Methionin through SN2 nucleophilic substitution
